column1: # *** THE MONTEVIDEO REELS THAT COVER JANUARY 1791 - 14 September 2026. ***
# Recovered from FamilySearch catalogue record *** koha:961086 *** ("Registros parroquiales, 1726-1998",
# Iglesia Matriz, Montevideo), reached by the Information panel of an image rather than the catalogue
# search box, which was returning "Something Went Wrong" for every query all day.
# *** Three reels cover the marriage date, and one of them is the military register this archive only
*** THE LIBROS CASTRENSES - FOUND, AND THEY HAVE A REGIMENT'S NAME ON THEM ***
column2: *** "Bautismos, matrimonios y defunciones, 1781-1814 (del Regimiento de Infanteria de Buenos Aires)" *** - filmed together with the "Catalogo de libros parroquiales, 1726-1932", the Real Cuerpo de Artilleria del Rio de la Plata books 1810-1820, and others.
column3: *** DGS 7713373 *** (film 2124160, items 5-13). Held at the FamilySearch Library, International B1 Floor.
column4: *** SANCHO WAS A SOLDADO, and this archive had never once looked in a military register. *** The IEGU holdings list named three Libros Castrenses covering 1781-1814; the FamilySearch catalogue now names the unit. *** The span covers January 1791 with ten years either side. *** *** NOT A FINDING, A PLACE TO LOOK: *** nothing says Sancho served in the Regimiento de Infanteria de Buenos Aires, only that he was a soldier in the Banda Oriental in the right decade. The register could hold his marriage, or have nothing to do with him.

column1: *** AND MONTEVIDEO'S OWN MARRIAGE REGISTER COVERS 1791 ***
column3: *** DGS 7713382 *** (film 2124219). FamilySearch Library, International B1 Floor.
column4: The Iglesia Matriz marriage book runs unbroken from 1726 to 1826. *** If the couple married at Montevideo rather than Canelones - and the venue has never had a source - this is the book. *** The archive has searched Montevideo full text repeatedly; this is the register itself.

column1: *** AND THERE IS AN INDEX TO IT, 1726-1800 ***
column2: *** "Indices de bautismos, matrimonios y defunciones (2 libros), 1726-1800" *** - on the same reel as "Indices de bautismos 1726-1998 (G-Z)" and "Indices de matrimonios, 1800-1998".
column4: *** TWO INDEX BOOKS COVERING EXACTLY THE PERIOD, AND NEITHER HAS BEEN OPENED. *** An index of Montevideo marriages ending in 1800 is a small book that would answer the Montevideo half of the question in one opening under L, *** just as Canelones has its own index of marriages 1776-1947 on DGS 8166578 item 10. *** *** So BOTH candidate parishes have a period index, and NEITHER has ever been read. *** That is the cheapest unrun test in this archive.
